# Snippets

> 255 curated terminal commands — search, pin and copy

- Live: https://snippets.neorgon.com/
- Part of the Neorgon tool suite (free, no signup, runs in your browser): https://neorgon.com/
- Covers: bash, macOS, Windows PowerShell, Git, Docker, Kubernetes, jq/yq, curl, ffmpeg, ImageMagick, PDF tooling, Claude Code
- Filters are shareable via the URL hash, e.g. https://snippets.neorgon.com/#q=amend+author&cat=git
- Keywords: snippets, shell, bash, powershell, git, macos, windows, ffmpeg, cheat sheet, search, copy
